public-domain.label: Public domain
public-domain.explanation: Out-of-copyright or dedicated to the public domain. In-browser viewing and download are allowed with archival attribution.

open-licence.label: Openly licensed
open-licence.explanation: Shared under a Creative Commons open licence. In-browser viewing and download are allowed with required creator attribution.

permission-granted.label: Permission granted
permission-granted.explanation: Displayed with documented community or creator permission. Download depends on the contributor's stated access terms.

restricted.label: Restricted
restricted.explanation: View-only metadata inside the archive. File download and external reuse are disabled pending community custodian approval.

metadata-only.label: Metadata only
metadata-only.explanation: Catalogue description only; no file is stored or previewed until source rights and consent are verified.
